description: Co. Longford Scenic Routes is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Longford County Council. This dataset records the locations of scenic views designated under the Longford County Development Plan 2009-2015. These are digitsed along road vectors and are numbered and classified as full and intermittent, in accordance with the corresponding designation in the document text. Coverage: Longford County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Longford County Council. Its tags are environment, longford, road, road network, society. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
